Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] effect play a [Ballistamon] card from the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?

Effect: [On Play] You may play [Ballistamon] from your hand or from under one of your Tamers without paying its memory cost.
[Your Turn] When you play a Digimon with [Xros Heart] in its traits, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
